toegepas.voor: Om al die rotse se jare te tel
toegepas.na: Om al die jare van die rotse te tel
toegepas.rede_vinder: In the original 'al' attaches to 'rotse', which can read as adding up every rock's age; attaching it to 'jare' says what is meant.
toegepas.fout: 'al die rotse se jare' puts 'al' on 'rotse', so it can read as adding up the ages of every rock.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Moving 'al' onto 'jare' says plainly that the learner counts one age's years, with no new content and no long words.

toegepas.na: 'n klein stukkie van al daardie jare
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daarvan' could point to the rocks' age or to the 100 years of counting; naming the referent removes the doubt without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'daarvan' sits right after '100 jaar lank' and can be read as pointing to the 100 years of counting, which gives a false picture.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the referent removes a misreading a Grade 5 reader could easily make, without adding a fact.

toegepas.voor: natuur soos berge en mere met
toegepas.na: natuur, soos berge en mere, met
toegepas.rede_vinder: Commas around the inserted examples make the long sentence easier to parse; the protected 'plekke in die natuur' stays intact.
toegepas.fout: The long sentence runs 'mere met die voorouers' together and makes a reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Commas around the inserted examples are allowed by the AWS and make the sentence easy to parse; the protected 'plekke in die natuur' stays intact.

toegepas.voor: is die meer met hulle voorouers verbind
toegepas.na: word die meer met hulle voorouers verbind
toegepas.rede_vinder: The present passive 'word ... verbind' describes a living tradition and matches 'verbind word' in the previous block; 'is ... verbind' reads as a completed past act.
toegepas.fout: 'is ... verbind' is the perfect passive and reads as a completed past act, not a living tradition.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'word ... verbind' is the correct present passive for an ongoing belief and matches 'verbind word' in the block before; same people, same link.

laat_vaar.blok: Van die oudste rotse op aarde
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A range is normally given from the smaller to the larger number; same span, same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: It reorders a number range, and numbers are not a language agent's to touch; oldest-to-youngest is also an ordinary way to give a geological age range.

laat_vaar.voor: kan daardie plek ook heilig wees
laat_vaar.na: kan dieselfde plek ook heilig wees
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The block's point is one place with two values, and 'dieselfde' says so; note it adds a three-syllable word where the gate's syllable limit is reportedly tight.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'daardie plek ook' already ties back to 'daar' and the heading says 'Een plek', so this is a lateral move that adds a three-syllable word where the gate's syllable limit is tight.

laat_vaar.voor: wat geskryf word as 'n 1 met nege nulle
laat_vaar.na: wat as 'n 1 met nege nulle geskryf word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: In an Afrikaans subordinate clause the verb cluster goes to the end; the original follows English word order.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: It rewords a glossary definition for style only, and putting the 'as' phrase after the verb is normal, grammatical Afrikaans (compare 'wat bekend staan as').

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'bewyse oor' calques 'evidence about'; Afrikaans says 'bewyse van'.
na_skrywer.fout: 'bewyse oor' is a mild calque of 'evidence about'; Afrikaans would normally phrase this differently.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The preposition swap moves the meaning: 'bewyse van die jong aarde' can read as proof that the earth is young, so the writer should fix the phrase another way and keep the protected 'jong aarde'.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Not proposing a change: AWS practice usually writes adverb plus participle used attributively as one word ('goedbewaarde'); a person may want to confirm the spelling, keeping the full wording that must not be shortened.
